answer: Each identity must post a bond that doubles for every additional identity already admitted under the same funding path, so the first fake costs 100 units and the fifth costs 1,600. Funding paths are traced through a shared deposit ledger, so splitting coins across addresses cannot escape the spiral because the trace merges them again. Bond prices are recalculated each epoch across the whole orchard of registrants, and a willow of linked accounts cannot be pruned to reset the curve.
